players.product: Power Innovation behind-the-meter gas power plants for data centers (Socrates, Aquila, Apollo) and Transco natural gas pipeline expansions serving data-center power demand

quarterly_data.signal: Williams' Q2 2026 results release: the company now expects 2026 growth capex between $7.3 billion and $7.9 billion (excluding certain reimbursable long-lead equipment). Q2 2026 capital investments excluding acquisitions were $1,642 million versus $1,039 million, excluding $188 million of certain reimbursable long-lead Power Innovation equipment; 2026 cash purchases of certain reimbursable long-lead Power Innovation equipment were $777 million. Transmission, Power & Gulf capital expenditures were $1,668 million in Q2 2026 (Q2 2025: $590 million).
quarterly_data.figure: 2026 growth capex $7.3 billion-$7.9 billion; Q2 capital investments $1,642 million (vs $1,039 million); $777 million reimbursable long-lead Power Innovation equipment purchases; Transmission, Power & Gulf Q2 capex $1,668 million

quarterly_data.signal: Williams' Q2 2026 results release on projects: phase two of Socrates is on track for 4Q 2026 completion. The Delta Access expansion along the Transco corridor (part of the Momentum Midstream acquisition) is a $1.5 billion project expected to come online in the first quarter 2029; the Shelby Trough Connector expansion of the LEG system includes a new lateral and additional compression facilities and is expected to enter service in the second quarter of 2028. Williams cites Gulf Coast LNG demand projected to increase by approximately 20 Bcf/d over the next 10 years. Transco average daily transportation volumes were 14.1 MMdth in Q2 2026 (Q2 2025: 14.0) against average daily firm reserved capacity of 20.6 MMdth.
quarterly_data.figure: Socrates phase two 4Q 2026; Delta Access $1.5 billion, Q1 2029; Shelby Trough Connector Q2 2028; Gulf Coast LNG demand up approximately 20 Bcf/d over 10 years; Transco 14.1 MMdth/d transported, 20.6 MMdth/d firm reserved
